_comment: Single source of truth for Suno field facts used by the generator and QA checker. Verified against research/01-suno-platform.md (sources dated 2026-09-09 to 2026-10-31). Re-verify with the suno-researcher agent whenever Suno ships a new model; Suno retired every pre-v6 model on 2026-09-09.

notes.v6: Flagship (Pro/Premier). Best prompt adherence and structure-tag following; cleanest, most polished mix. Reported slightly narrower stereo than the previous generation and mixes that can go muffled after ~2:30 in standard mode, so run Max Mode for full-length beats.
notes.v6-wild: Exploration checkpoint (Pro/Premier). Deliberately drifts from the prompt, more genre-blending and texture, unpredictable length. Defaults Variety to Off. Not the same as high Weirdness.
notes.v6-mini: Faster, lighter, available on Free. Closer to v6 than to wild, a little flatter with more artifacts. Use for cheap palette tests or if you are on the Free plan.

mode.name: Custom (Advanced) mode
mode.note: Help pages still say Custom; hands-on reports of the v6 web UI say Simple / Advanced / Sounds with a More Options panel. Both names are in circulation.

exclude.tip: Bare terms, comma-separated, never prefixed with 'no'. Hands-on testers report Exclude bites hardest with a short list; if Suno ignores it, trim to the 4 most important terms.

title.status: unverified (sources say 80 or 100); 80 used as the safe bound

weirdness.hipHopRange: 20-40 commercial, 40-55 experimental; above 60 community reports tempo shifts, odd instrumentation and structure drift

styleInfluence.hipHopRange: 50-70 for specific engineered prompts; 70+ when the Style field is thin

audioInfluence.status: only appears when audio is uploaded; never used by suno-forge

variety.default: Normal on v6 and v6-mini; Off on v6-wild
variety.why: Any setting above Off rewrites and expands the Style text before the model sees it (official FAQ: 'reduce the Variety slider to 0 to retain full control of your style tags'). Engineered prompts must run at Off.

maxMode.recommended: ON for any instrumental over ~2:00; OFF for 30-60 s palette tests
maxMode.status: official: 'best for songs longer than two minutes'; cost multiplier from in-app tooltip

duration.note: Custom hard-cuts at the value; Auto tends to run long on v6. Set Custom to the planned runtime plus a small buffer and let [End] stop it early; Crop any tail.

instrumental.method: Custom (Advanced) mode -> Instrumental toggle ON -> Variety OFF -> Lyrics field holds bracketed structure/production tags only (no words) -> Exclude Styles lists vocal terms as bare words.
instrumental.lyricsTagsHonored: Community consensus (hands-on 2026-09-16): yes, bracket tags are followed as structure with the toggle on. [End] works most of the time; named breaks are the most reliable mid-song tags.
instrumental.inlineNegatives: Weak or counterproductive in Style ('remove the humming' produced more humming). Negatives go in Exclude Styles only.

personas.uiName: Voices (formerly Personas; Style Personas live inside the Voices menu)
personas.note: In-app text: 'Songs with Voices cannot be instrumental.' Not used in this workflow.

features.extend: Extend adds music after a chosen point (max 8 min total). Paste only the remaining section tags into the Extend lyrics box.
features.replaceSection: Replace Section (Pro/Premier, Song Editor): highlight the region, edit the tags/prompt, get two versions. Use it on a leaked hum or an ignored break instead of re-rolling.
features.remaster: Remaster (Pro/Premier) renders subtle variations and runs on v6; use it on the keeper for a cleaner, louder master.
features.crop: Crop trims start/end on the waveform (Pro/Premier).
features.stems: Get Stems (Pro/Premier): Auto Split up to 12 stems for 50 credits; Split from Mix 10 credits per stem; Advanced Split (choose from ~100 instruments) 10 credits per stem, Premier only.
features.studio: Suno Studio (Premier) is a browser DAW; exports are not subject to download caps.
features.credits: Standard generation: 2 songs for 10 credits. Max Mode: 20. Free 50/day (v6-mini only), Pro 2,500/mo, Premier 10,000/mo. Download caps since 2026-09-03: Free 7 lifetime, Pro 20/mo, Premier 60/mo.
features.artistNames: Suno silently rewrites prompts containing artist names ('We don't reference artists directly, so we've replaced your prompt with similar styles you might like'), so a name costs you control of the whole Style field.

baseExclude._comment: Hands-on testers report Exclude Styles bites hardest with a short list (2-4 bare nouns); the generator defaults to core vocal terms + up to 4 lane guards (~8 terms). 'full' is the belt-and-braces preset; 'short' is the minimal one.
